inventory.answer: Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany

decision.explanation: Both 'Knight Bachelor title' and 'Berliner Kunstpreis' are directly supported by the original sources. D1S1–D1S17 describe Klebe being awarded the Knight Bachelor title by Queen Elizabeth II, while D2S1–D2S18 detail his receipt of the Berliner Kunstpreis in 1986. These are two distinct awards from separate documents and contexts. The third candidate, 'Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany,' is not mentioned in any of the provided sources and thus cannot be accepted.
